newsitem.title: UK: Telewest shares rise on new customer figures.
newsitem.headline: Telewest shares rise on new customer figures.

text.p: Shares in Britain's biggest cable television and telephone company Telewest Communications were higher on Wednesday after the company announced a 33.8 percent increase in its total residential customer base.
The shares were up 5p at 131p by 1428 GMT in volume of over two million shares.
Telewest said in a statement that its fourth quarter had been "very strong" and that half of its clients now took both cable TV and telephone services.
Telephone customers were up 45.5 percent over last year at 627,009 whilst cable TV customers rose 31.5 percent to 528,142.
The shares hit a low of 117-1/2p in December after falling around 38 percent in the last six months.
